get.summary: The caller's latest notifications, newest first
How many of the caller's notifications are unread

post.summary: Mark all the caller's notifications as read
Send this device's pushes to the caller (a device belongs to whoever signed in on it last)
Stop pushes to this device (call before signing out)

patch.summary: Mark one of the caller's notifications as read or unread

delete.summary: Delete one of the caller's notifications

post.summary: Create a draft contract owned by the caller

get.summary: List the contracts the caller owns, accesses or validates, newest first
Get a contract with its participants

409.description: Only a draft can be deleted

delete.summary: Delete a draft (owner); its audit log stays

400.description: The sealed material or its signature does not check out

409.description: The contract or someone's keys changed meanwhile: reload and seal again

post.summary: Seal or re-seal the contract (owner): the encrypted secret, the wrapped key and shares, and the signed manifest

404.description: Contract not found or not sealed

get.summary: What the caller's role may download of the sealed contract (owner: envelope and key; validator: their share; accessor: the manifest until release)

409.description: Not possible in this status, or the contract changed

post.summary: Revoke the contract (owner): every ciphertext is deleted

get.summary: The contract's audit log, oldest first (hash chain the app can verify)
Check the contract's audit log on the server

422.description: The account has no verified email

post.summary: Create or sync the caller's profile from their verified identity (idempotent; call after sign-in)

409.description: The caller is the accessor or a validator of someone else's contract

get.summary: List the users the caller trusts

404.description: The caller does not trust them

get.summary: List the users who trust the caller (with their contact details)
Search users by first/last name (partial) or email (exact), excluding the caller and users they already trust
Get a user profile (contact details only if they trust you)

400.description: Malformed keys or a signature that does not verify

post.summary: Register the caller's first public keys (signed by the caller)

400.description: Malformed keys, a signature that does not verify, or the current keys again

403.description: Reverification needed: the body is Clerk's reverification hint (clerk_error), handled by useReverification

409.description: key_version is not the next one, or the keys changed meanwhile

post.summary: Replace the caller's lost or compromised keys (signed by the new keys, next key_version). Needs a Clerk reverification less than 10 minutes old; others may use the new keys after a quarantine (72 h).

get.summary: Public keys of some users: the caller, people they trust and people who trust them. Users without keys are left out.

type.description: Kind of notification, e.g. trust_added. Unknown kinds may appear: show them as generic.

body.example: Sam Durand vous a ajouté à ses proches.

data.description: Includes `url`, the app screen to open when tapped

read_at.description: When it was read; null while unread

token.description: Expo push token of this device

push_enabled.description: Push for non-critical notifications. Critical ones (a claim on your contract) are always pushed.

description.description: Short description visible to every participant: never put anything secret here

accessor_id.description: Clerk ID of the accessor (must be someone the caller trusts)

validator_ids.description: Clerk IDs of 1 to 3 distinct validators (people the caller trusts), in order

email.description: User email. Only returned for yourself and for users who trust you.

phone_number.description: User phone number. Only returned for yourself and for users who trust you.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the profile was created

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the profile was last updated

description.description: Short description visible to every participant

status.description: draft (not sealed yet) → active → claimed → released; revoked. Changed only by actions.

sealed_version.description: Number of the current sealing; 0 while a draft

allowed_actions.description: What the caller may do now; the app shows only these actions (rules live in the backend)

owner.description: Owner profile; null if it no longer exists

accessor.description: Accessor profile; null if it no longer exists

validators_list.description: Validator profiles, in the order of `validator_ids`

description.description: Short description visible to every participant

status.description: draft (not sealed yet) → active → claimed → released; revoked. Changed only by actions.

sealed_version.description: Number of the current sealing; 0 while a draft

allowed_actions.description: What the caller may do now; the app shows only these actions (rules live in the backend)

owner.description: Owner profile; null if it no longer exists

accessor.description: Accessor profile; null if it no longer exists

wrap.description: The share wrapped to that validator (HPKE X-Wing), base64

expected_version.description: The contract version the owner saw

accessor_id.description: Must be someone the caller trusts, with keys

owner_wrap.description: The contract key wrapped to the owner, base64

manifest_signature.description: Ed25519 by the owner over the RFC 8785 JSON of the manifest, base64

wrap.description: The share wrapped to the caller, base64

manifest_signature.description: The owner's Ed25519 signature of the manifest, base64

envelope.description: Owner only: the encrypted secret, base64

owner_wrap.description: Owner only: the contract key wrapped to them, base64

expected_version.description: The contract version the owner saw

seq.description: Position in the contract's log, from 1

actor_id.description: Who did it; null for the system

body.description: Canonical JSON (RFC 8785) of the details, exactly as hashed

occurred_at.description: ISO 8601 with milliseconds, exactly as hashed

prev_hash.description: Hash of the previous event (64 zeros for the first)

hash.description: hex SHA-256 of prev_hash, seq, occurred_at, contract id, type, actor_id ('' if null) and body, joined by \n

broken_at.description: First seq that does not verify

trusted_id.description: Clerk ID of the user to trust. The owner is the caller.

fingerprint.description: hex SHA-256 of both keys; its first 30 digits are the security code

signature.description: The user's signature of these keys, base64

usable_from.description: Others may encrypt to these keys from this time (later than created_at after a reset)

signature.description: Ed25519 signature, base64, by the signing key over the RFC 8785 JSON of {type: 'behindme/v1/key-registration', user_id, key_version, kem_public_key, signing_public_key}
